# stax-cert (`SMC17/stax-cert`)

> Lean 4 formalization seed for categorical foundations of gradient-based learning (Para, Lens, CRDC, and backprop functor).

- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/stax-cert
- **Related (`zig-substrate`)**: https://github.com/SMC17/zinging
- **Author / Org**: https://github.com/SMC17

- `StaxCert/Para.lean` — `ParaHom`, `idPara`, `compPara`
- `StaxCert/Lens.lean` — `LensHom`, `idLens`, `compLens`, lens laws
- `StaxCert/CRDC.lean` — `LeftAdditive`, `CRDC`
